title: Jademir Lake
wikitext:
[[File:Jademir Lake.jpg|thumb|Jademir Lake]]

'''Jademir Lake''' is a medium sized lake in northern [[Feralas]] with a small island, [[Dream Bough]], at its center. Dream Bough contains a portal to the [[Emerald Dream]], guarded by [[Lethlas]] and several [[green dragonspawn]].

[[Noxious Whelp|Infected green whelps]] can be found on the northwestern shore.

* [[File:WoWlogo.png|40px]] '''Patch 1.4.0 (2005-04-19):''' There is no longer water missing on the shore of Jademir Lake in Oneiros in Feralas.
